hook.say: Turkey against the world! Which one is bigger? Five duels, three seconds each. The last one surprises almost everyone.

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: Türkiye or Germany?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Turkey or Germany?
questions.fact: Türkiye is more than twice the size of Germany.
questions.sayAnswer: Turkey! It is more than twice the size of Germany.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Türkiye or France?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Turkey or France?
questions.fact: Türkiye is about 40% bigger than mainland France.
questions.sayAnswer: Turkey! It is about forty percent bigger than mainland France.

questions.q: Which is the biggest: Türkiye, Japan or Italy?
questions.say: Which is the biggest: Turkey, Japan or Italy?
questions.fact: Türkiye is bigger than Japan and Italy combined.
questions.sayAnswer: Turkey! It is bigger than Japan and Italy combined.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Türkiye or Nigeria?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Turkey or Nigeria?
questions.fact: Nigeria is about 18% bigger, and has nearly three times the people.
questions.sayAnswer: Nigeria! It is about eighteen percent bigger than Turkey, and has nearly three times as many people.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Türkiye or Namibia?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Turkey or Namibia?
questions.fact: Namibia is 5% bigger than Türkiye, with only about 3 million people.
questions.sayAnswer: Namibia! It is five percent bigger than Turkey, with only about three million people.
